attempts.summary: For prefix x define M10=sum of its ten known exceptional values and S10=the number of those ten values that are positive. The remaining 38 exceptional slots have nonnegative integral pairings with total remaining mass e-M10. Hence every completion has full exceptional support at most S10+min(38,e-M10). Combining with the retained necessary support lower bound K=ceil((d-16g+16)/4) yields the exact monotone predicate S10+min(38,e-M10)>=K.

proof: The ten indexed exceptional coordinates already contribute exactly S10 positive exceptional slots and exactly M10 units of exceptional mass.
Every additional positive exceptional slot among the 38 unassigned exceptional slots consumes at least one unit because all exceptional pairings are nonnegative integers.
Therefore at most min(38,e-M10) additional exceptional slots can be positive in any completion.
The retained Stage32 branch requires full exceptional support at least K=ceil((d-16g+16)/4). If the upper bound is below K, no completion can satisfy the required support.
